title: Plan class: migration (shared acceptance invariants)
description: The CLASS rubric schema/data-migration plans' acceptance rubrics reference (acceptance-rubrics-on-every-plan-2026-08-11 D-006): migrations land through the allocator + runner with consumers updated and integrity proven. Graded at plan completion by a NON-implementer.

criteria.title: Allocator-numbered, runner-applied, no runtime DDL
criteria.model: The migration's number came from the atomic allocator (never ls-by-eye), it iterated as .DRAFT, was armed at libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql/, and applies via the runner — no ensureXxx()/inline CREATE TABLE anywhere in the change.
criteria.method: Check migration_reservations for the number; confirm the .sql is armed and applied (schema present); grep the change for runtime DDL.
criteria.driftMarkers: Hand-picked NNN; a .DRAFT left unarmed while code assumes the schema; DDL executed from app code.

criteria.title: Schema consumers and fixtures updated
criteria.model: pull-schema.mjs was re-run and every consumer of the changed shape is updated — including hand-rolled integration-test fixtures that mirror the table, and sites stranded by a new required field.
criteria.method: Confirm the regenerated schema artifact is in the change; run lint:required-field-strands --typecheck for tightened shapes; grep sibling *.integration.test.ts fixtures naming the table.
criteria.driftMarkers: A fixture one column behind; a stranded constructor found later by the fleet gate.

criteria.title: Integrity verified; destructive change snapshotted first
criteria.model: For a data-moving/destructive migration, a backup snapshot preceded it and pre/post invariants (counts, checksums, spot rows) were compared — integrity is measured, not assumed.
criteria.method: Find the backup:snapshot_create id in the record; read the pre/post verification queries and their outputs.
criteria.driftMarkers: Destructive DDL with no snapshot id on record; 'looks right' in place of a compared invariant.

criteria.title: The reversal path is stated before arming
criteria.model: The record states how to undo: a down-path, a restore point, or an explicit 'irreversible — owner-acknowledged' marker set BEFORE the migration armed.
criteria.method: Read the plan/work-item for the reversal note; for irreversible changes, find the acknowledgement preceding the arm.
criteria.driftMarkers: Rollback reasoned about only after something breaks.

criteria.title: The independent grader audits the audit
criteria.model: The independent grader opens a sample of the implementer's plan-audit citations and confirms each sampled code/test reference resolves against the current tree and actually supports the audited item — the audit verdict itself is never accepted as proof.
criteria.method: Read the subject plan's effective per-item audit. Spot-check at least one resolving code/test citation (and expand the sample after any mismatch): open the cited current blob, compare it with the item requirement and audit claim, and record what was checked. Treat doc, workitem, and none citations as declarations of non-verification, never substitutes for code truth.
criteria.driftMarkers: A grade copied from the audit's PASS label; no cited blob opened; a stale blob hash ignored; doc/work-item prose treated as proof that code exists.
